Sensei.pageIntro: Conversations you start with “Ask AI Tutor” on a question, a glossary term or a textbook unit, with “AI Tutor review” on the quiz page, or with “Ask anything” below are kept here. Answers are based on the audited explanations and the textbook's terms.
Sensei.keyHowTo: You can create a key under API Keys in the Anthropic Console. Usage is billed to your own Anthropic account.
Sensei.threadsNote: Conversations are stored only in this browser (up to {max}; the oldest is removed first).
Sensei.threadsEmpty: No conversations yet. Start one with “Ask AI Tutor” on a question, a glossary term or a textbook unit, with “AI Tutor review” on the quiz page, or with “Ask anything” below.
Sensei.freePlaceholder: Ask anything about the IT Passport exam…
Sensei.freeHint: Terms in your question are looked up in the textbook glossary, and the answer is based on their definitions. Anything not in the glossary is answered from general knowledge and marked as such. Each question starts a new conversation.
Sensei.freeTermsFailed: The glossary terms could not be loaded. Please try again.
Sensei.threadMissing: This conversation can’t be opened: its first question can’t be found (this browser’s storage can’t be read, or the saved copy is gone).
Sensei.freeEmptyHint: Ask anything about the IT Passport exam. Terms in your question are answered from their glossary definitions.
Sensei.reviewIntro: The topics where your accuracy is lowest, from your answer record. Open one and AI Tutor sums up the pattern in your mistakes and suggests real past questions to try next.
Sensei.reviewEmpty: Answer {min} or more questions in a topic and AI Tutor will analyze your weak spots
Sensei.reviewAllCorrect: Every topic where you have answered {min} or more questions is all correct
Sensei.reviewOpener: I'd like to review my weak points in this topic
Sensei.reviewEmptyHint: AI Tutor sums up the pattern in the questions you got wrong in this topic and suggests past questions to try next.
